title: Mixture of Tunable Experts - Behavior Modification of DeepSeek-R1 at Inference Time
reasoning: The paper presents a technical method (MoTE) for controlling specific model behaviors, such as refusal responses and reasoning language, by modifying expert routing in Mixture-of-Experts architectures. While it discusses 'safety alignment' and 'refusal' mechanisms, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or specific ethical/moral reasoning frameworks.
